title: 657 of 3628 comment units in D5-s8's cells hold a sentence over 40 words (criterion C5)
claim: 657 D5 units (870 sentences) of the seat's 44 files hold a sentence longer than 40 words, after splitting each unit at blank, list, usage and indented lines; the longest is 524 words (tests/deployment_shape.py module docstring, a closure-census history from 'That is a selection cost'), the vendored markdown-it.min.js excluded as third-party.
mechanism: Comments carry long dash-joined argument chains; nothing in the gate measures sentence length.

evidence.contention_note: count; contention-immune (other seats on the box)
